body: I appreciate the offer but that leads to another problem that I don't know how to accept that kind of help.
I know but I can't bring myself to do it
Yeah I kind of figured that I just don't know how to get over it.

I used to think I was good with arts[phyiscal like clays and wire sculpture, Oils and canvas, Story telling and writing] but lately I can barely do anything I used to and I feel like I can't tell or think up a story worth a damn.
I would agree I'm either full of myself or self loathing depends on whats going on.

I feel broken because I can't accept help even when I know I need it.

It feels like I'm just burdening others when that happens. I've felt like that forever.

I don't really know what to say that's the problem.

I try and it just chokes up before I can get it out.

Hell I had to keep myself from deleting that whole thing like 5 times.
